name: Ampicillin + sulbactam
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 1.5 g (ampicillin 1 g + sulbactam 0.5 g) to 3 g (2 g + 1 g) IV or IM every 6 hours

key_interactions.effect: Raises and prolongs ampicillin and sulbactam levels (label).
More skin rash with ampicillin-class drugs (label).

contraindications: Serious hypersensitivity (anaphylaxis, Stevens-Johnson syndrome) to ampicillin, sulbactam or other beta-lactams
Previous cholestatic jaundice or hepatic dysfunction with ampicillin-sulbactam

pk.peak: IM 1 g/0.5 g: ampicillin 8 to 37 mcg/mL, sulbactam 6 to 24 mcg/mL
pk.half_life_eskd: About 5 hours at CrCl 15–29 and 9 hours at CrCl 5–14 (label Table 3)
pk.excretion_renal_pct: 75% to 85% of each unchanged in urine in 8 hours

sources.citation: Roerig. (2026). UNASYN (ampicillin sodium and sulbactam sodium) for injection [Prescribing information; US FDA-approved label, NDA050608, set ID 155c7ec0-5862-404f-b1d0-f278f8a8bbda, version effective July 10, 2026]. DailyMed, U.S. National Library of Medicine.
